mode.title: Mode
mode.description: "Top articles" returns a ranked chart per country or language project for one day. "Article timeseries" returns daily views per article over a date range.

countries.title: Countries (top mode)
countries.description: ISO country codes, e.g. US, GB, DE, IN, BR, KE. One chart per country (all languages combined).

projects.title: Wiki projects (top mode, optional)
projects.description: Language projects instead of / in addition to countries, e.g. en.wikipedia, de.wikipedia, ja.wikipedia. One chart per project (worldwide views).

date.title: Date (top mode, optional)
date.description: YYYY-MM-DD. Empty = latest published day (stats lag about one day; the actor steps back automatically).

topN.title: Chart depth (top mode)
topN.description: How many ranked articles per chart (API serves up to 1000).

excludeSpecialPages.title: Exclude non-article pages (top mode)
excludeSpecialPages.description: Skip Main Page, search pages and other non-article namespaces so charts contain real topics.

compareWithPrevious.title: Compare with previous run (top mode)
compareWithPrevious.description: Remember ranks between runs and report previousRank, rankChange and isNew. Turn on with a schedule for daily movement tracking.

articles.title: Articles (timeseries mode)
articles.description: Article titles exactly as on Wikipedia, e.g. Bitcoin, Taylor Swift, ChatGPT.

project.title: Wiki project (timeseries mode)
project.description: Which language edition to read views from, e.g. en.wikipedia, es.wikipedia.

daysBack.title: Days back (timeseries mode)
daysBack.description: Length of the daily view history per article (up to 365).

maxRows.title: Max rows per run
maxRows.description: Cap on rows returned. Controls total cost.
